patch.summary:
Choose ClickFunnels only if your buying job matches “Funnel and landing-page platform for creators and marketers — a primary Kartra peer for al” rather than WhatConverts's shape. Choose WhatConverts only if your buying job matches “Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo ” rather than ClickFunnels's shape. Workflow advantage: ClickFunnels leans funnel-building, landing-pages; WhatConverts leans analytics. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: ClickFunnels is Funnel and landing-page platform for creators and marketers — a primary Kartra peer for all-in-one funnel stacks.; WhatConverts is Lead tracking and call attribution for marketers and agencies — Call Tracking from $30/mo with Plus/Pro/Elite ladders..
- Workflow coverage skew: ClickFunnels-leaning funnel-building, landing-pages, marketing-automation vs WhatConverts-leaning analytics.
- Researched limits: ClickFunnels — No forever-free plan — paid entry from Launch; WhatConverts — Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — ClickFunnels: No forever-free plan — paid entry from Launch; All-in-one funnel breadth can be heavier than a dedicated ESP; WhatConverts: Specialist lead/call tracking — not a full marketing suite; Usage overages can dominate TCO.
